newsitem.title: SPAIN: TABLE-Gas Natural H1 group net down 0.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Gas Natural H1 group net down 0.9 pct.

text.p: Results for six months to end-June for Gas Natural group (in billions of pesetas, unless stated):
Investment in fixed assets 33.9 vs n.a.

NOTE: The Gas Natural group said unit sales margins declined both in the industrial and domestic segments. This was due to lower tariffs as well as the narrower spread between purchase and sale prices because of lower crude prices in the first four months of the year.
Total group gas sales were up 22.5 percent to 69.27 billion therms in the first half.
The overall rise in sales was attributed to the industrial market and to electricity firms, which compensated for a decline in the domestic market because of a mild winter.
Domestic sales fell 6.1 percent to 13.63 billion therms while they rose 19 percent to 40.60 billion therms in the industrial sector year-on-year.
Sales to electricity companies and other distributors almost doubled, rising to 15.0 billion therms.
Gas Natural said industrial sales and the numbers of clients had increased in the second quarter of 1997 versus the first.
The company said the first-half result also reflected the impact of an asset restatement in 1996.
